# Starter Relay Circuit Diagnostic

**Make**: Toyota
**Model**: Camry
**Year**: 2010
**Diagnostic Code**: P0615

## Description and Procedure
When starter clicks but engine does not crank, inspect relay contacts and terminal 30 voltage. Ensure battery terminal clean.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0615 on 2010 Toyota Camry.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
